description: This file defines the TasksRepository class, which provides data access methods for TaskEntity objects, acting as a data repository layer interfacing with the TaskDao.

classes.name: TasksRepository
classes.description: Repository for TaskEntity data access, providing methods to observe, retrieve, insert, update, and delete tasks.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits all TaskEntity objects as a list, allowing reactive observation of task changes.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves a TaskEntity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Suspending function that inserts a new TaskEntity and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Suspending function that updates an existing TaskEntity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Suspending function that deletes a given TaskEntity.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Suspending function that returns the total number of TaskEntity records.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Suspending function that inserts a list of TaskEntity objects.
